rccg_open_heavens.title: HE SPEAKS PEACE
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
message: After Jesus resurrected from the dead, He entered the room where His disciples had gathered because they were afraid and immediately told them, "Peace be unto you" (John 20:19). In John 14:27, Jesus also said:
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

Jesus gives His followers peace because He is the Prince of Peace (Isaiah 9:6). In Mark 4:35-41, the Bible tells us that Jesus and His disciples were in a ship, and a massive storm arose. While they were scared for their lives and were trying so hard to manage the situation, Jesus was sleeping peacefully. The moment they woke Him up, He issued only one decree, "Peace, be still," and everything became calm. In the name above every other name, I decree that the peace of God that passes all understanding will rest upon you at all times, in Jesus' name.

Today's memory verse tells us that God speaks peace to His people. It is important to understand that God is never the author of confusion or chaos (1 Corinthians 14:33). Whenever you sense confusion or chaos around you, know that the devil is at work because James 3:14-16 says that where envying and strife are present (which are earthly, sensual, and devilish), there is confusion and every evil work. When the earth was in a state of chaos and darkness covered the face of the deep in Genesis 1:2, God's word brought order to the situation.

Beloved, whenever you are in a state of confusion and chaos, cry out to God for help and listen to what He has to say to you. His Word will always bring peace and show you the way out of the situation. To receive the peace that the Prince of Peace gives, however, you must surrender your life to Him. People who insist on living on their own terms will not enjoy the peace of the Lord because His peace thrives only where His way is followed, and His will is done.

God wants to speak peace into any troubled water that might exist in your life. To enjoy His peace, however, you must never insist on calming any storm you may be facing your own way. Surrender to God totally, and His peace shall rule every facet of your life.
prayerPoints: Key Point: God's peace rules where His way is followed and His will is done.

mfm_mfm.title: Mountain Top Life Daily Devotional
mfm_mfm.author: Dr. D.K. Olukoya
mfm_mfm.motivationalQuote: Get rid of that stain that makes you a stench in God's nostrils.
mfm_mfm.propheticWord: God will purge you of all impurities, in the Name of Jesus.
message: The third prerequisite a vessel must meet to be used by God is that it must be clean. A cup that is dirty will not be used by anyone to drink water, no matter how thirsty the person is. As an unclean cup is unhygienic and harmful to health, so will an unclean vessel turn out to be a liability in spiritual affairs. God is holy; He cannot use unclean, filthy instruments.

Impurity in the form of sinfulness is fundamentally against God's holy nature. God cannot use an unclean, double-minded person. God had to expose and deal with the uncleanness in Isaiah's life before He used him greatly as a messianic prophet. In (Isaiah 6:5), Isaiah acknowledged that he was a man of unclean lips.

Perhaps it is the laboratory of your heart that needs cleansing. Many allow lust, evil thoughts, bitterness, and secret grudges to flow unchecked. Whatever it is that has made you a vessel unto dishonour, you can turn to God today and the touch of His purging fire will cleanse and sanctify you spirit, soul, and body (1 John 1:9).
morningPrayers: Anointing of holiness and spiritual purity, fall upon me now, in the name of Jesus.
Blood of Jesus, purge my heart, my mind, and my thoughts, in Jesus' name.
eveningPrayers: O God, arise and make me a vessel unto honour, sanctified and meet for Your use.
Holy Ghost fire, consume every root of secret compromise in my life, in Jesus' name.

dclm_dclm.title: DCLM Daily Manna
dclm_dclm.author: Pastor W.F. Kumuyi
dclm_dclm.thoughtForTheDay: True meaning and lasting satisfaction are found only in the unchanging God.
message: Human history, for all its dazzling scientific advancements and technological novelties, repeats itself in basic spiritual and moral patterns. Fashion styles from decades ago are recycled as 'latest trends'. Political systems rise and fall upon the same ambitions and frailties.

King Solomon, endowed with unrivaled wisdom and boundless wealth, explored all earthly pursuits—wealth, architecture, knowledge, sensory pleasure, and fame. Yet in (Ecclesiastes 1:9), he arrived at an unflinching conclusion: 'The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.'

Worldly achievements without God are empty bubbles that burst at the touch of eternity. Those who chase after the fleeting pleasures of this world inevitably discover the bitter vanity at their core (1 John 2:17).
Beloved, let your heart find its rest in Christ Jesus, the same yesterday, today, and forever (Hebrews 13:8). Build your life upon His enduring Word.
prayerPoints: Lord, deliver me from the deceptive vanity and distractions of this present world.
Father, anchor my soul firmly in Your unchanging Word and righteousness, in Jesus' name.

rccg_rccg_ss_adult.title: RCCG Sunday School (Adult Students)
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.memoryVerseText: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.introduction: Water baptism is a cardinal ordinance in Christianity instituted by Jesus Christ for every believer who has surrendered their life to Him.

outlines.title: Outline 1: Significance and Biblical Mode of Baptism
points: 1. Baptism by immersion symbolizes identification with Christ's death, burial, and resurrection (Romans 6:3-4).
2. It is a public confession of internal transformation through faith in Christ Jesus (Galatians 3:27).

outlines.title: Outline 2: Prerequisites and Spiritual Impact
points: 1. Genuine repentance and faith in Jesus Christ are prerequisites (Mark 16:16).
2. Water baptism does not save by itself; it seals the believer's covenant walk with God (1 Peter 3:21).

rccg_rccg_ss_adult.discussion: Why did Jesus, who knew no sin, submit Himself to John's baptism in Jordan?
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.summary: Water baptism is non-negotiable for true discipleship.
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.assignment: Witness to one unsaved person and encourage a newly converted believer to enroll for water baptism classes.

christ_embassy_rhapsody.title: Rhapsody of Realities
christ_embassy_rhapsody.author: Pastor Chris Oyakhilome
christ_embassy_rhapsody.memoryVerseText: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
christ_embassy_rhapsody.confession: I am born from above! The incorruptible life of God works mightily in my spirit. I walk in divine vitality and victory daily in Christ Jesus!
message: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the Word of God which liveth and abideth forever! Hallelujah! In (1 Peter 1:23), God reveals the supernatural origin of your new life.
This means failure, sickness, fear, and spiritual death have zero legal jurisdiction over your physical body and circumstances (2 Corinthians 5:17).
The Word of God is your spiritual mirror. Look into it daily and align your confessions with what God says about you. Speak the Word boldly!

odm_odm.title: Our Daily Manna
odm_odm.author: Bishop Dr. Chris Kwakpovwe
odm_odm.memoryVerseText: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
odm_odm.devotionalCapsule: When God is ready to perform His wonders, protocols are suspended and mockers are silenced!
message: Beloved, our God is never late! Even when the clock of life appears to have ticked to the final second and your adversaries have already written your spiritual obituary, Jehovah El-Shaddai steps into the arena and reverses the irreversible! (Psalm 126:1).
Don't lose your joy because of temporary setbacks or stubborn delays. Delay is never denial in God's kingdom agenda. Hold on to your faith!
God is setting an ambush against your adversaries, and your mockers shall soon gather to congratulate you!
prayerPoints: O God of eleventh-hour miracles, arise and turn my captivity around this month, in Jesus' name.
Every power assigned to prolong my struggle, expire by fire, in the name of Jesus.

rccg_open_heavens.title: More Than a Conqueror
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
message: Life is full of battles. From the moment we are born until we leave this world, we experience different challenges. However, when a person comes to Christ, everything changes. Through Christ, the believer becomes a new creation, and the battles of life no longer have to determine the outcome. Instead of struggling without hope of victory, the believer can live with the assurance of victory in Christ.

Romans 8:37 tells believers that they are more than conquerors through Christ. A conqueror fights and defeats an enemy to obtain victory, while someone who is more than a conqueror enjoys a victory that has already been achieved. As believers, we are recipients of the victory Jesus has won.

Jesus went to the cross, defeated the devil, and secured victory for humanity. After His resurrection, He declared that all authority in heaven and on earth had been given to Him (Matthew 28:18). He then gave power to His disciples through the Holy Spirit (Acts 1:8).

When the disciples received the Holy Spirit, they began to operate in the authority Christ had given them. They cast out demons, healed the sick, preached the gospel, and continued to spread the message of Christ even when they encountered persecution. When persecution caused believers to scatter, they used the opportunity to preach the gospel in other places (Acts 8:1–4). Philip, for example, went to Samaria, where many people received the message and the city experienced great spiritual impact (Acts 8:5–8).

Being more than a conqueror does not mean that you will never face challenges. Rather, it means that when challenges arise, you can face them with the confidence that God can work through them for His purpose. What appears to be an attack can ultimately become an opportunity for God to accomplish His plan.

The death of Jesus on the cross is a powerful example. The enemy intended the crucifixion for destruction, but God used it to accomplish salvation. 1 Corinthians 2:8 explains that the rulers of that age did not understand the wisdom of God in what was taking place.
Therefore, remain confident in Christ. Trust God even when circumstances appear difficult, knowing that He can turn situations around and cause His purpose to prevail.
prayerPoints: Key Point: Being more than a conqueror means that you will always triumph over the enemy's plans.
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: Conquerors and Overcomers Now Are We

rccg_open_heavens.title: WEEP NOT
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness.
message: Sometime ago, I was praying during a programme and God said, "Open your eyes." I was almost going to say, "Lord, but I'm praying"; however, I obeyed. As I opened my eyes, I saw a woman in the congregation, her face soaked in tears, weeping as she prayed. Then, God said, "Go and tell her, 'Weep not.'" I moved towards the congregation, approached her, and tapped her as I said, "God said, 'Weep not.'" Her eyes brightened, and I returned to the altar to continue praying. A year later, that same woman stood before me, along with some other people who wanted me to pray for them. When it was her turn for me to pray for her, I greeted her and said, "Sister, how can I help you?" She opened her mouth and could only mutter, "Jesus". I asked her a second time how I could help her, and she only said, "Jesus" again. I asked her a third time, and she said the same thing. I began to get impatient because there were other people in the queue. Eventually, she got herself together, and she told me that she was the woman whom God sent me to tell not to weep the previous year. She then told me that she was crying that day because she had been married for over ten years without any children, and her husband's relatives were urging him to send her packing if she didn't give birth to any children soon. As she shared her story, I immediately understood why she found it difficult to speak at first; she was holding a baby in her right hand and another in her left. God turned her seemingly hopeless situation into an occasion for rejoicing. I pray that God will turn any seemingly hopeless situation that might exist in your life around and fill your mouth with laughter, in Jesus' name.

Beloved, if you have surrendered your life to the Lord Jesus Christ, my Daddy is saying to you today, "Weep not," just like Jesus said to the widow of Nain in today's Bible reading. Every time Jesus says, "Weep not," it is because He wants to perform a miracle. No matter how long you may have been weeping, your time of rejoicing has come. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy will surely come in the morning (Psalm 30:5). I decree that your days of rejoicing are here, in Jesus' name.
prayerPoints: Father, thank You for putting an end to my weeping and for bringing me into my days of rejoicing.
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: What A Friend We Have In Jesus

rccg_open_heavens.title: GOD OF HOPE
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
message: After Jesus died, His disciples became afraid and lost hope. John 21:3 tells us that Peter said to the other disciples, "I go a fishing." He wasn't going to fish for souls; instead, he was returning to his old job because he had lost hope. He must have thought to himself, "We thought Jesus Christ was going to rescue us from all those who are oppressing us. We thought that the age of miracles had come to stay, but now He has been crucified on a cross." When Peter told the other disciples that he was going fishing, they joined him because they had also lost hope. They felt that the best thing they could do was to return to fishing. However, Jesus appeared to them that morning as they fished and restored their hope. As they struggled to catch fish, Jesus called out to them and showed them where to cast their net. He turned their hopelessness into joy. I declare that God will show up for you and turn every hopeless situation you may be experiencing around, in Jesus' name.

Child of God, when all hope is lost and people have given up on you, do not give up on yourself. If, peradventure, you have given up on yourself, do not give up on God because He will always show up for the hopeless when they turn to Him. Today's memory verse calls Him 'the God of hope'

Some years ago, a young man was travelling from Kaduna, a state in Northern Nigeria, to Lagos with some other people in a vehicle. While they were on their way, they had an accident and everyone in the vehicle died except the young man. He was taken to a hospital because he was still breathing, even though he was unconscious. He was in a coma for several days, and every once in a while, he would wake up and shout, "Jesus," before returning to the coma. After a while, the doctors concluded that his case was hopeless, but they couldn't bury him because he was still breathing. Then one day, he awoke, cried out 'Jesus!', opened his eyes, and never slipped back into the coma. That young man is still alive today.

Beloved, I pray that if there is any situation in your life that people around you have concluded to be hopeless, you will receive a new lease of life from the Almighty that will transform it into a testimony, in Jesus' name.
prayerPoints: Key Point: The Almighty God is a God of hope; therefore, you must never lose hope.
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: 'Tis So Sweet To Trust In Jesus
